recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if PA decides to refresh or prune the historical Administration PowerPoint source deck; no current FHIR core source change is needed for FHIR-11414.
issue_request: FHIR-11414 asked to improve Administration module wording around Billable Item. The approved resolution was to remove BillableItem from the diagram and remove the note underneath that described Billable Item as the proposed link between encounters and billing/claiming systems.
initial_application: The request appears to have been applied by commit afc33fcde84154dbff3d0d83cc7bcb3ad9ed8264 on 2016-10-04, a Jira-tagged bulk reconciliation commit naming tracker 11414. It replaced the obsolete Billable Item note in source/administration-module.html and updated Administration interactions diagram assets.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml keeps administration-module.html in current build scope. Current source/administration-module.html references the interactions diagram and contains the Coverage/Claim Finance note rather than the obsolete BillableItem note. Current source/image path searches found no BillableItem/Billable Item text. The PowerPoint source deck still has older exploratory slides, including one with "* Billable Item", but it is stale relative to the current built PNG and is not the build-scoped page input. FHIR-11469 is the same Administration diagram change family and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the current build-scoped Administration module already omits BillableItem from the relevant current diagram surface and no longer contains the obsolete note.

related_jiras.note: The same 2016 application commit also implemented the related Administration diagram request to distinguish resources from other modules; FHIR-11469 already has its own combined-branch audit commit.
